user.title: Improved Shopping List Dev
user.description: Copy the catalog, categories, recipes, purchases, stock, prices and appearance/shop preferences once. Accounts, readers, gateways and notifications are excluded; automations are disabled. Use a separate list to isolate its items too, or allow a shared original list: completing or deleting items will affect both panels.

data.allow_shared_list: Allow sharing the original list (item changes affect both panels)

error.original_unavailable: The original integration must be configured and loaded to copy its data.
error.original_list: Choose another list or explicitly allow sharing its items with the original.

abort.already_configured: Already configured. Use Configure to change the default list.

init.title: Default shopping list
init.description: Choose the list that opens by default in the panel.
